root_owned_requests.change: append recipes web-install, web-dev, web-build, web-serve, web-test (exact text below)
root_owned_requests.text:
# Local web fixture (prototype). Loopback only; no hosted deployment.
web-install:
    cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

web-dev port="5173":
    cd web && pnpm exec vite dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port {{quote(port)}} --strictPort

web-build:
    cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline && pnpm run check && pnpm run build

web-serve port="3000" control_api="":
    cd web && HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT={{quote(port)}} VIDEO_UTILS_CONTROL_API_URL={{quote(control_api)}} node serve.js

web-test:
    PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_web_stack -v

root_owned_requests.change: align control API with the assumed subset: GET /api/v1/sources -> {schema_version:1, sources: SourceSummary[]}; GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id} -> JobSnapshot (closed objects; nullable progress with explicit denominator; nullable eta_seconds); 404 for unknown job
root_owned_requests.why: BFF schemas are an assumption (control_api_contract_source: assumed_s2_subset_pending_web_jobs) until a merged web_jobs contract exists

operator_notes: A fresh host needs one online `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before `web-build` (offline) succeeds.
Start only via `node serve.js` (or `just web-serve`); it refuses any HOST other than 127.0.0.1/::1 with exit 2.
VIDEO_UTILS_CONTROL_API_URL accepts only http://127.0.0.1:<port> or http://[::1]:<port>.
